Tooltip_SignalSmoke_Grenade: Throw it: colored smoke rises for about a minute and a half, visible from afar. Zombies standing in the smoke lose sight of their target.
Tooltip_SignalSmoke_RoadFlare: Burns red for about an hour of game time once lit and placed on the ground.
Tooltip_SignalSmoke_Chemlight: Activate it and place it on the ground: a soft colored glow for several hours, silent and without smoke. Once activated, it cannot be turned off.
Tooltip_SignalSmoke_ChemlightLit: Glowing. On the ground it lights its surroundings; picked up, it keeps glowing until it is spent.
Tooltip_SignalSmoke_ImprovisedSmoke: Throw it: colored smoke, shorter than a military smoke grenade. Homemade, it sometimes fizzles without smoke. Zombies standing in the smoke lose sight of their target.
